items.title: General Motors (GM) Could Be 17% Undervalued After $220 Million OnStar Settlement
items.summary: General Motors (GM) is back under the microscope after agreeing to a US$220 million settlement over its OnStar app, which regulators alleged misled more than 370,000 drivers about data collection and sharing. For investors, the backdrop is mixed. General Motors shares have fallen 3.55% over the last day and are down over the past week. items.title: GM Slides 7% From a 52-Week High as New York Files Its $220 Million Driver Data Settlement
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors fell 7% in two days from a 52-week high as New York filed its share of a $220 million driver data settlement. New York’s attorney general said GM’s OnStar app told more than 370,000 drivers they weren’t enrolled while GM collected and sold their data.
